card.name: Units and verbs inside dosing and recipe steps
card.fires_on: Instruction words in step-by-step text, such as a cooking verb like cook, or the unit mg or per right after a number in a per-kg dose. Also fires on step-number periods in recipes.

modes.label: Dose unit before per-kg
modes.description: The unit mg or the word per after a number, leading into a weight-based dose such as /kg.
modes.example: Pediatric patients older than three years of age: a single dose of 50<< mg>>/kg (up to 2 g)

modes.label: Recipe step words
modes.description: A cooking verb or step-number period at the start of a recipe instruction.
modes.example: In a large nonstick skillet,<< cook>> chicken in oil over medium heat for five

card.writes: The suppressed tokens are action verbs like Place, Put, Take and Fix, so it seems to discourage starting a new imperative step.
card.plain: It lights up on the unit right after a dose number and on cooking verbs in recipe steps.
